entities.name: Piru
entities.description: An Elder Dragon, life-partner of Chromium Rhuell and mother of Crosis, killed by Dakkon Blackblade.

entities.name: Chromium Rhuell
entities.description: An Elder Dragon, Piru's mate, who survived the Elder Dragon War.

entities.name: Crosis
entities.description: A primeval dragon, child of Piru and Chromium.

entities.name: Elder Dragons
entities.description: Dragons spawned by the Ur-Dragon in the Birth of the Elder Dragons when Dominaria was young.

entities.name: Ur-Dragon
entities.description: The dragon that spawned the Elder Dragons.

entities.name: Elder Dragon War
entities.description: A war instigated by Nicol Bolas that few Elder Dragons survived.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Instigator of the Elder Dragon War.

entities.name: Geyadrone Dihada
entities.description: A planeswalker who served by Piru and Chromium, who planned Piru's death to absorb her energy.

entities.name: Dakkon Blackblade
entities.description: A planeswalker who fought Piru and Chromium and killed Piru with the Blackblade.

entities.name: Blackblade
entities.description: A weapon forged by Dakkon at Dihada's urging, used to kill Piru.

entities.name: Dueling Chasm of Golthonor
entities.description: A chasm created by the energy blast released when Piru was killed.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane of the Elder Dragons.

events.summary: Piru and Chromium Rhuell survive the Elder Dragon War instigated by Nicol Bolas.
events.quote: Piru and Chromium were among the very few Elder Dragons who survived the Elder Dragon War

events.summary: Summoned by Geyadrone Dihada to fight Dakkon Blackblade, Piru and Chromium face him; Dakkon's mind control on Rhuell fails.
events.quote: since Elder Dragons are nearly as powerful as planeswalkers, Dakkon failed

events.summary: Dakkon sends Rhuell away and kills Piru with the Blackblade, creating the Dueling Chasm of Golthonor.
events.quote: Piru then fought him but was killed when Dakkon stabbed her with the Blackblade

events.summary: Geyadrone Dihada absorbs much of Piru's energy, having manipulated Dakkon into forging the Blackblade and killing Piru.
events.quote: Geyadrone Dihada absorbed much of Piru's energy and had planned the dragon's death all along

relations.quote: the life-partner of Chromium Rhuell and mother of Crosis
both Piru and Chromium were servants of the planeswalker Geyadrone Dihada
Piru then fought him but was killed when Dakkon stabbed her with the Blackblade

relations.note: planned her death to gain Elder power
relations.quote: she wanted the power of an Elder but knew this could only be gained when such a dragon died
she had Dakkon forge the Black Blade
